name: llm-adapter
description: One binary for every LLM provider: routes, rotates keys, falls back, streams
input: an openai-style request body on stdin: {"messages": [...], "model": ...}
output: an openai-style completion on stdout, or sse lines with --stream, logs kept on stderr

cost.detail: cost is whatever the configured provider charges, this module adds nothing

needs: provider api keys in config.yaml (copy config.yaml.template)
